title: 第一卷 第13章 大量击杀
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

女人没有丝毫的犹豫。

反正继续下去，只有一个死。

死了物资也是这个男人的。

签订了，至少还有机会活着。

“检测到求生者像你发起成为附属木屋的请求，是否签订契约！”

脑海种的提示音响起。

这个契约的签订，只有求生者相互在附近，就可以直接签订！

秦龙立马同意了签订。

下一秒，女人已经成为了秦龙的附属木屋。

来不及看对于附属木屋的特权，秦龙拿出了大威力左轮手枪！

因为看到女人的脚步已经站不稳了。

“嘭，嘭，嘭”

震耳欲聋的声音在这里响起。

几个围在石头周围的丧尸被秦龙精准的爆开了脑袋。

以前使用手枪的手感还在，没有消失！

女人似乎被这枪声给吓到了，呆呆的朝着秦龙这边看去。

可惜这个角度，她看不到秦龙。

但此时，她已经知道自己的主人叫什么！

这个名字，在昨夜木屋排名榜出来以后，几乎是全球出名了。

女人更是知道，这个秦龙，就是她这个区域里面的第一名。

全球排名第二的大佬，跟自己是同一区域！

而现在，自己竟然就这么神奇的遇到了这个大佬，还成为了这个大佬的附属木屋。

一股难以言明的感觉涌上心头。

那是一种劫后余生，说不清道不明的感觉。

身上的那一股劲一松懈，脚下一下子站不稳，直接朝着石头下面掉了下去。

身体直接砸在了丧尸的尸体上面。

好在并没有受伤。

在女人的视觉里面，那些朝着自己而来的丧尸。

此时一个接一个脑袋炸开，腐烂恶心的尸体一个个地倒在自己的身边。

那枪声，根本不停，仿佛子弹永远都用不完一样。

短短不到一分钟的时间。

视线之中，再没有一个活着的丧尸，全都变成了尸体！

满地都是丧尸死后爆出来的东西，看着有点耀眼。

女人呆呆地看着眼前的一切。

这就是全球排名第二的实力吗？

拥有枪械这种热武器，并且枪法准得要命。

没有一发子弹是打空的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The woman didn't hesitate at all.

Anyway, if we continue, only one will die.

Even if he dies, the supplies belong to this man.

If you sign it, you at least have a chance to live.

"It has been detected that a survivor has requested you to become an attached cabin. Do you want to sign a contract?"

A reminder sounded in my mind.

This contract can be signed directly as long as the survivors are nearby!

Qin Long immediately agreed to sign.

The next second, the woman had become Qin Long's auxiliary wooden house.

Before he had time to see the privileges for the attached wooden house, Qin Long took out a powerful revolver!

Because he saw that the woman's steps were unsteady.

“Bang, bang, bang”

A deafening sound sounded here.

Several zombies surrounding the stone had their heads blown open by Qin Long accurately.

The feeling of using a pistol before is still there and has not disappeared!

The woman seemed to be frightened by the gunfire and looked towards Qin Long blankly.

Unfortunately, from this angle, she couldn't see Qin Long.

But at this time, she already knew the name of her master!

This name has become almost globally famous after the wooden house ranking list came out last night.

The woman even knew that this Qin Long was the number one in her area.

The second-ranked boss in the world is in the same region as himself!

And now, I unexpectedly met this big boss so magically, and became his auxiliary cabin.

An indescribable feeling came over me.

It was an indescribable feeling of surviving a disaster.

As soon as the strength in his body relaxed, he suddenly became unsteady on his feet and fell directly under the stone.

The body hit the zombie's body directly.

Fortunately, he was not injured.

In the woman's vision, the zombies are coming towards her.

At this time, heads exploded one after another, and rotten and disgusting corpses fell beside him one by one.

The gunshots never stopped, as if the bullets would never be used up.

In less than a minute.

There was no living zombie in sight, they all turned into corpses!

The ground is full of things that explode after zombies die, which looks a bit dazzling.

The woman stared blankly at everything in front of her.

Is this the second best strength in the world?

He has hot weapons like firearms and his marksmanship is extremely accurate.

Not a single bullet was empty.
